Plus, multiblade razors touted for closer shaves, are notorious, especially in darker skinned individuals, for triggering ingrown hairs, irritation, texture, and therefore darkening of the skin, because of the texture of our hair. A good underarm shaving routine can really help! #hyperpigmentation #shaving #bodycare #underarm #skincare

Exploring the MUST-DRIVE Roads in Xinjiang: Where Every Turn Changes the Season | WALKIN XINJIANG·Road. Want a road trip that changes with every curve? Welcome to Xinjiang.
 
 With over 230,000 km of highway – enough to circle half the globe – this isn’t just driving. It’s like turning the pages of a living landscape photo book. One minute you’re cruising past snow-capped peaks, the next you’re rolling through lavender fields so vast they touch the horizon.
 
 We took on Asia’s most epic drives:
 Yizhao Highway, open just 100 days a year, where each bend shifts the season
 Panlong Valley Road, a winding green tunnel through forests straight from a fairytale
 Duku Highway, where deserts, canyons and meadows unfold outside your window
 Then we cranked it up a gear – riding shotgun in a Dakar Rally truck, drifting over golden dunes where the only rule is the thrill of the drive.
 
 Xinjiang doesn’t just have roads. It has routes that rewrite what a road trip can be.

 10 stories from Xinjiang, through the eyes of Hong Kong.
 We travel beyond borders. We connect beyond cultures.

ad_a_text: I’m blind: is the ballet accessible to me? 🩰  Ad✨  Come with me to find out! 💃  I’m so excited that the Royal Ballet and Opera have introduced audio described performances! 🎭 We watched Alice in Wonderland and even got to go ON stage and look at the props and costumes as part of a Touch Tour! 🎟️  It really helped me appreciate the intricacy and detail that goes into every set, and being able to see it up close truly brought the story to life for me! ♥️   Listening to the live audio description; I felt the dancers dominating space with powerful grace.  Every movement poised between strength and softness, control and fluidity.  Its majesty in motion: as their bodies rise, fold and soar in silent dialogue, perfectly in unison with the commanding presence of the orchestra.  It truly is a multisensory experience. 🧡 Have you ever been to the ballet? What did you watch? 💜 Video description: Sassy outside of the Royal Opera house does a delicate spin in a long pink dress. She and Grant clink champagne flutes together. Sassy stands at the stage doors inviting you to come in. A panning sweep of the entire stage, an auditorium can be seen, different sets and Sassy touching the props. She shows you her audio description headset and describes what it looks like. More footage of the costumes, props and sets. Sassy talks about the arabesque she attempts to enact the same grace and poise… more panning shots, and a final shot of the entire cast on stage at the end of the show. #ballett #thingstodoinlondon #london #royalballet #blind #accessibledaysout

Don’t forget to my code CAIT15 for 15% off all plans !!  ⭐️ Pre-book your airport transfer. Either arrange it through your riad/hostel or book one in advance to avoid getting scammed at the taxi rank. ad_b_text: ad. What do you think of my wooden Christmas wreath? ☺️🎄🌟 Would you believe it started life as a preloved side table I found in my local thrift store?! I’m honestly so happy with how it turned out! It’s bright, bold, and full of festive cheer... and the best bit? I get to bring it out year after year  ❤️ If you’re making any festive projects with Sharpie markers this season, please tag me! ad_b_text: Cake Decorating 101 | Part 4 of 10 This cake is all about colour and getting the little ones involved 🥰 We used the iconic Smarties (for obvious nostalgic reasons). It's super easy to work with, and make decorating a breeze (parents, you’re welcome). This is the kind of cake where kids can jump in, sprinkle freely, arrange the patterns, and proudly say, “I made this.” 💛 #cakedecorating #BirthdayCakeIdeas #FoodiesofSACakeDecoratingSeries #NestleChocolates #NestleSmarties  TOTAL TIME: 1 HR 15 MINS PREP-TIME: 15 MINS COOK TIME: 1 HOUR LEVEL: EASY INGREDIENTS 2 boxes (600g each) vanilla flavoured cake mix (and all ingredients required for the box mix) 6 boxes (40g each) Nestlé Smarties Chocolate 1 tub store-bought chocolate icing METHOD 1. Preheat oven and prepare two 23cm cake pans by spraying with non-stick spray and lining with baking paper. Alternatively bake the mix as cupcakes. 2. Mix the cake batter per the box instructions. Chop 1 box of Nestlé Smarties Chocolate and gently fold it into the cake batter. Pour the batter into the prepared cake pans or cupcake papers and bake. Allow to cool completely on a wire rack, then refrigerate until firm, approximately 1 hour. 3. Take a small cutter or object, like a mug or bowl, to mark a circle in the exact center of both cakes. Using a sharp knife, cut out and remove the center piece from both cakes, leaving you with two large cake rings. *Chef's tip: alternatively use a bundt cake tin 4. Divide each cake ring into four quarters. Remove the top-right quarter from the first ring and the bottom-right quarter from the second ring. 5. Look at the inner edges of the remaining two large 'C' shapes. Trim a very small, crescent-shaped piece off the inner edge of both C-shapes where they will meet in the middle to form the figure-eight. This ensures the two main pieces can touch and join cleanly. 6. Carefully arrange the two large C-shaped pieces onto a serving board, pushing the trimmed edges together in the center to form the number '3'. 7. Apply a thin layer of the store-bought chocolate icing all over the cake to seal any crumbs. Chill for 15 minutes. Then, apply a smooth, thick, and even second layer of icing over the entire surface of the assembled number cake. This acts as the "glue" for the Smarties decoration. 8. Sort the remaining whole Smarties by colour. Starting at the edges, lay the whole Smarties onto the iced cake in neat rows or distinct color lines. Press each Smartie gently into the icing to secure the colourful, patterned finish. Alternatively, arrange the cupcakes in a number 3 shape, ice to join the cupcakes together and decorate with Smarties. 9. Refrigerate the decorated cake for at least 15 minutes to allow the icing to set and the Smarties to adhere firmly. 10. When ready, use a sharp knife to slice and serve this fun, festive Smarties Celebration Confetti Cake, and ENJOY!

ad_a_text: “Once I started drinking, I couldn’t stop. That’s when I realized—I wasn’t just a heavy drinker. I was an alcoholic.” In this powerful Recoverycast episode, @Riley🐠 shares the moment everything clicked. After years of justifying her drinking—binges that ended in blackouts, switching drinks to try to “control” it, drinking when she didn’t want to—Riley sat in treatment and heard one question: 👉 Once you start drinking, can you stop? ad_a_text: Soft & Fluffy Milk Powder Cake – A Sweet Eid Delight! 🍰✨   Celebrate Eid with this Milk Powder Cake – light, airy, and packed with rich, milky flavour! Made with simple pantry staples, it's an easy yet delicious treat to share with family and friends.     Ingredients:   🥛 2 ½ cups East End Milk Powder   🍚 ⅔ cup sugar   🧁 1 tbsp baking powder   🥚 3 eggs   🌿 ¼ cup vegetable oil   🥛 Dashes of milk (as needed), Caramel Sauce or Dulce De Leche  Method: 1️⃣ Toast the milk powder – Lightly toast the milk powder in a pan for a few minutes, making sure to keep stirring to prevent clumping and burning. Remove from the stove. 2️⃣ Combine dry ingredients – mix the toasted milk powder, baking powder, and sugar until well combined.   3️⃣ Whisk wet ingredients – In a separate bowl, beat the eggs, oil, and a dash of milk until smooth.   4️⃣ Mix together – Gradually add the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, stirring until a batter forms. Add more milk if needed to get a better consistency.   5️⃣ Bake – Pour the batter into a greased cake tin and use a spoon to flatten the thick cake batter to fit into the cake tin. Bake at 180°C for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.   6️⃣ Let it cool before adding the caramel sauce. Slice then enjoy this soft and fluffy Eid treat!     Would you make this for your Eid celebrations? Minimal effort. 🙌 Our Chakalaka Sausage Bake with Fry’s Classic Sizzlers is the ultimate weeknight or weekend winner – hearty, colourful, and ready in just 35 minutes.
